It does not exercise depth, subject Z, ceiling height, units changes, or stale-context rejection. Range validation and callback rejection are implemented in the reviewed production source; unexercised cases are not demonstrated failures.

The manual-room class only asserts undo enabledness. The adjacent precision workflow actually invokes room undo/redo and checks saved/unsaved state plus unchanged modifier width, but does not reopen room to inspect restored dimensions. Manual-room relaunch does explicitly check committed width and X. Production commits start an owned history transaction and end it on dismissal; callbacks validate generation, presentation owner and unchanged non-room scene. No reachable conflict or lost-edit defect established.
